bio.text: Danny Alvarez represents District 69 in the Florida House of Representatives. According to the House, Alvarez was elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.
The House lists Alvarez's residence as Hillsborough County, an occupation of lawyer, and military service in the U.S. Army. Alvarez was born in Miami.
Alvarez's listed education includes a B.S. from the University of Florida, an M.S. from Troy State University, a J.D. from Stetson College of Law and an LL.M. from the University of Miami.

sources.title: Biography for Representative Daniel Antonio "Danny" Alvarez
